name: youtube-subtitles-transcription
title: YouTube Subtitles & Transcription
description: Download YouTube subtitles, audio and video, including whole playlists and channels, and transcribe or translate any recording locally with whisper.cpp
author: davidrosic

commands.name: youtube-download
commands.title: YouTube Download
commands.subtitle: Subtitles, audio, video & playlists
commands.description: Download subtitles in any language and format, audio or video from a YouTube link, or subtitles for a whole playlist or channel

commands.name: transcribe-selected-files
commands.title: Transcribe Selected Files
commands.subtitle: Finder · whisper.cpp
commands.description: Transcribe or translate the audio and video files or folders selected in Finder with whisper.cpp

commands.name: transcription-queue
commands.title: Queue
commands.subtitle: Transcriptions & playlist downloads
commands.description: See running, queued and finished transcriptions and playlist subtitle downloads, cancel them, and open the results. The queue keeps running when you close Raycast.

commands.name: queue-menu-bar
commands.title: Queue in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Progress while jobs run
commands.description: Shows transcription and playlist download progress in the menu bar while the queue is running

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Where subtitles, audio, video and YouTube transcriptions are saved

preferences.name: ytDlpPath
preferences.title: yt-dlp Executable
preferences.description: Optional; otherwise found in PATH or common Homebrew locations

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Executable
preferences.description: Needed for MP3, M4A and MP4, subtitle conversion, and transcription

preferences.name: browserCookies
preferences.title: Browser Sign-In
preferences.description: Off by default. Choose the browser you're signed in to YouTube with to download age-restricted, private and members-only videos. yt-dlp reads that browser's cookies on your Mac; they are never sent anywhere else.

preferences.name: whisperPath
preferences.title: whisper.cpp CLI
preferences.description: Path to whisper-cli; auto-detected in ~/GitHub/whisper.cpp when available

preferences.name: modelPath
preferences.title: Default Whisper Model
preferences.description: Path to a ggml model, such as ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin; found next to whisper.cpp when not set. Other models in the same folder can be chosen when transcribing.

preferences.name: skipSilence
preferences.title: Voice Activity Detection
preferences.label: Skip silence with Silero VAD
preferences.description: Transcribe only the parts with speech. This stops whisper from inventing text during silence and music, and is faster.

preferences.name: vadModelPath
preferences.title: Silero VAD Model
preferences.description: Optional; ggml-silero-v6.2.0.bin (885 KB) is downloaded automatically when not set

preferences.name: notifyWhenDone
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when the queue finishes
preferences.description: Show a macOS notification when everything in the queue is done

preferences.name: whisperLanguage
preferences.title: Transcription Language
preferences.description: Spoken language to preselect when no favorite language matches, for example Serbian or auto

preferences.name: favoriteLanguages
preferences.title: Favorite Caption Languages
preferences.description: Comma-separated language names or codes; case and '(orig)' are ignored (for example Serbian, English)
